data.name: Abraq
data.gender_notes: Abraq is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘abr’, meaning night or darkness. In Islamic tradition, the name Abraq is associated with the concept of divine protection and the comforting darkness of the night. The name Abraq carries the meaning “Night, Darkness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abraq usually hope their child will grow to embody night, darkness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection, guidance, and comfort.
data.etymology: Abraq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, Darkness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abraq total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: ابرق
in_arabic.meaning: مكان مرتفع، موضع عال، جبل صغير أو هضبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: يأتي اسم أبرق من الجذر العربي (ب ر ق) الذي يعني الارتفاع أو الاشتقاق من البرق. يشير إلى مكان مرتفع أو هضبة، وغالبًا ما يستخدم لوصف المناطق الجبلية الصغيرة أو التلال. في بعض الأحيان، يرتبط بالبرق أو الضوء الساطع. وقد ورد ذكره في بعض الأوصاف الجغرافية في القرآن والسنّة النبوية.

in_urdu.name: ابرق
in_urdu.meaning: اونچی جگہ، بلند مقام، چھوٹا پہاڑ یا پہاڑی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابرق کا نام عربی جڑ (ب ر ق) سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند یا اونچا۔ یہ کسی بلند جگہ، چھوٹے پہاڑ یا ہضبے کو بیان کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ بعض اوقات اس کا تعلق برق یا تیز روشنی سے بھی جوڑا جاتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں جغرافیائی وضاحتوں میں اس کا ذکر پایا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अब्रक
in_hindi.meaning: उंचा स्थान, ऊंचा स्थान, छोटा पर्वत या पहाड़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अब्रक नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल (ب ر ق) से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचाई या उच्च। यह किसी ऊंचे स्थान, छोटे पहाड़ या पहाड़ी को दर्शाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। कभी-कभी इसका संबंध बिजली या तीव्र प्रकाश से भी जोड़ा जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में भौगोलिक विवरणों में इसका उल्लेख मिलता है।

in_pashto.name: ابرق
in_pashto.meaning: لوړ ځای، لوړوالی، کوچنی غر یا غونډک
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ابرق نوم د عربي ريښې (ب ر ق) څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې لوړ يا پورته دی. دا د لوړ ځای، کوچني غره یا غونډک د بيان لپاره کارول کیږي. کله ناکله دا د برښنا يا شديد رڼا سره تړاو لري. په اسلامي دود کې د جغرافيائی معلوماتو کې يې ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.name: Abraq
in_english.meaning: High place, elevated location, small mountain or hill
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abraq originates from the Arabic root (ب ر ق), meaning 'to be high' or 'to flash'. It refers to an elevated place, a small mountain, or a hill. This term is used in Islamic tradition and geography, often describing natural highlands or landmarks. The root connection to 'barq' (lightning) also implies brightness or illumination, adding a spiritual dimension to its meaning.

data.cultural_impact: The name Abraq holds an intriguing cultural impact in the Islamic world, particularly in its association with the nomadic Bedouin Arabs of the Arabian Peninsula. In Bedouin folk tales and legends, Abraq is often depicted as a powerful spirit or jinn who protects travelers during their journeys through the desert, providing them with safety and shelter under the dark night sky. This protective presence of Abraq symbolizes the importance of community and support during challenging times.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Abraq carries profound implications for Muslims in their daily lives. The concept of the night (laylat al-qadr) in the Islamic faith holds great significance, as it is believed to be the night when God revealed the Quran to the Prophet Muhammad. In this context, the name Abraq encourages individuals to seek comfort, guidance, and divine protection within the tranquility of the night. It is a reminder that even in the midst of darkness and uncertainty, one can find solace and strength in the promise of God's endless grace and mercy.
